\[ \text{Speed} = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Time}} = \frac{60 \text{ km}}{1.5 \text{ hours}} = 40 \text{ km/h} \]

Now, to find out how many kilometers the train travels in 1 hour, we use the speed we just calculated:

\[ \text{Distance in 1 hour} = \text{Speed} \times 1 \text{ hour} = 40 \text{ km/h} \times 1 \text{ hour} = 40 \text{ km} \]

Therefore, the train travels 40 kilometers in 1 hour.
